reviews.text: I thought I was getting 2 but it was actually 1pc only. So far its been alright, I expected it to be like wakemake real ash brush liner that got discon already but its lighter than wakemake. You'll need several layers to see even the ash shade.
reviews.zh: 我以為會收到 2 支，但原來得 1 支咋。暫時用住算 OK，我本來期望佢好似 wakemake real ash brush liner 咁（已經停產），但佢比 wakemake 淡。就算想見到嗰隻 ash 色，都要疊幾層先睇得到。

reviews.text: I love the shade, love the thin brush tip, and it doesn’t budge once it’s down. The only failing is that the pigment is kind of thin, so it needs to be built up to not look patchy.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個色號，亦都好鍾意支幼筆頭，畫落之後完全唔會甩。唯一嘅缺點係顯色度比較弱，要一層層疊上去先唔會睇落一撻撻。

reviews.text: I love this shade I never use black because my makeup will look too thick and it doesn’t fit me well! It does get dry easily so you need to make sure to store it standing upside down or it will skip and not apply neatly or cleanly. I’ve been through 3 of these already and I will be repurchasing more! Lasting power is not as good and if your eyes water easily it will wipe off so make sure to use a magic sealer!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個色號，我從來唔用黑色，因為妝會睇落太厚同唔啱我！佢真係好易乾，所以一定要倒轉擺放，否則會畫到斷色、唔整齊、唔乾淨。我已經用完 3 支，遲啲會再回購多幾支！持久度就麻麻，如果眼容易標水會甩色，所以記住要用 magic sealer！

reviews.text:
Honestly I"m quite disappointed. 
Not sure if mine is dried out or faulty or something but its really hard to get any color to come out. And when it does, it's not coming out in a consistant line. 

It's like a really old ballpoint pen that you have to keep shaking and drawing circles just to get the ink to come out.

It's a shame. The color is nice - but this liner reminds me of a 16 year old pen at the bottom of a junk drawer.
reviews.zh: 講真，我幾失望。唔知係我支乾咗、定係有問題定係點，總之好難先畫到色出嚟。就算出到色，都畫唔到一條連貫嘅線。就好似一支用咗好耐嘅原子筆，要不停捽、畫圈，支墨先肯出。實在可惜。顏色係幾靚 —— 但呢支眼線筆畀我嘅感覺就好似抽屜底擺咗 16 年嘅舊筆咁。

reviews.text: This is the best eye liner I had ever try! Is so thin that is easy to make whatever shape you like and it last all the day no matter how I sweated buttt the two eyeliners I’d bought exploded and a lot of product was lost and is constantly dripping, I think that’s why it’s over so fast
reviews.zh: 呢支係我用過最好嘅眼線筆！夠晒幼，所以可以隨意畫出你鍾意嘅形狀，無論我幾出汗都keep到成日。不過我買嘅兩支眼線筆爆咗，流失咗好多產品，而且一直喺度滴緊，我諗呢個就係佢咁快用完嘅原因。

reviews.text: Makes it easy and quick to get a thin, sharp wing! Just note that if you have eyeshadow on the brush might pick up the powder and clog the eyeliner brush bristles a bit. Just wipe the liner on the back of your hand and give it a good shake if that happens.
reviews.zh: 輕鬆快捷畫到幼細銳利嘅眼尾！留意一下，如果你有搽眼影，支掃可能會黐到眼影粉，搞到眼線掃嘅毛有少少塞住。如果遇到呢個情況，喺手背擦一擦支眼線筆，再大力搖幾吓就得。

reviews.text: Amazing! I used to buy the Ash Brown from Wakemake but they are always out of stock. Now after this one, I actually prefer the texture of Clio, not as watery and its so easy to apply!
reviews.zh: 超正！我之前一直買Wakemake嘅Ash Brown，不過佢哋成日缺貨。用咗呢支之後，我發覺自己更加鍾意Clio嘅質地，冇咁水，而且好易上！

reviews.text: I've always loved the Clio Kill black eyeliners so I wanted to try some other colours. This grey is a dark charcoal grey and can be layered without becoming patchy. The component is metal and feels very well constructed and weighted for easy application. The tip is a very fine brush tip (not a felt-tip type) and the flow of product is very consistent with no bleeding
reviews.zh: 我一直都好鍾意Clio Kill黑色眼線筆，所以想試吓其他色。呢支灰色係深炭灰色，可以層層疊上唔會斑駁。支筆身係金屬，造工扎實有分量，畫起上嚟好就手。筆尖係好幼嘅掃頭（唔係毛氈筆嗰種），出墨好穩定，唔會化開。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
